deviceType: Reduced pressure zone assembly — selected 3/4–2 inch service parts
title: Watts 909 and LF909 repair kits for small-body assemblies
description: Use the official Watts repair references for selected 3/4–2 inch 909 and LF909 cover, check, relief, total-rubber, and total-service scopes.
summary: The 909 repair family is split by lead-free designation, size, and component scope. This record starts with official small-body references rather than presenting a false universal 909 kit.
statusNote: This page does not cover 2 1/2–10 inch 909 kits, RPDA variants, flood-sensor accessories, or every discontinued part. Confirm the model suffix and size on the body before ordering.
diagramAlt: Reduced pressure zone assembly showing first check, second check, relief valve, and service cover
identifiers: Verify whether the label reads 909 or LF909; original and lead-free kit references may be different or superseded.
The first-check, relief-valve, total-rubber, total-service, and cover scopes are different repair decisions.
Do not mix small-body 3/4–2 inch kits with the separate 2 1/2–10 inch 909 family.

kits.contents: First and second check-valve assemblies, relief-valve assembly, and lubricant.

kits.contents: Diaphragm, disc assembly, seat O-ring, relief-valve O-ring, piston O-rings, and lubricant.

kits.contents: Disc assembly, seat, seat O-ring, sleeve, check spring, PC cover, and cover O-ring.
